notes.title: May Playtesting Release
notes.content:
The May Release brings some major changes to the public playtesting build, featuring the current state of the reversion mechanic and a new vision for the visual direction of the Garden of Past.

Updates:
- New vertical slice demo set in the Garden of Past
- Completely reworked map generation system
- Integrated a new environment reversion mechanic
- Integrated first puzzles utilising reversion
- Added the playable prototype the new minion enemy
